items.title: No usable effect estimate for a lower threshold
items.whyItMatters: The only threshold study's interval includes no effect (claim c3).
items.opportunity: State the uncertainty to the board and recommend local monitoring if the threshold changes.

items.title: Costs without effects
items.whyItMatters: A cost per activation day is known (claim c2), but no study links costs to visits avoided.
items.opportunity: Present costs and effects side by side without a ratio.

items.title: Unequal benefit
items.whyItMatters: Low-income neighbourhoods benefit least from alerts (claim c4).
items.opportunity: Synthesise evidence on targeted outreach and transport.

items.title: Component effects unknown
items.whyItMatters: Studies rarely separate alerts, cooling centres and outreach.
items.opportunity: Describe component evidence separately and say where it is missing.

reevaluation: The gaps make the board's cost question premature; a narrative review can set out what is known about effects, thresholds, equity and costs, and what is not.
